events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and Monty Python co-founder John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his unique brand of comedy has truly shaped British humour. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, 'The Beatles' (commonly known as 'The White Album'), was released in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: On this day in 1968, The Beatles unleashed the iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that showed the Fab Four at their most experimental. What's your go-to track from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Legendary Frontman
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost one of music's most electrifying performers, Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's the Queen song that always gives you goosebumps?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Folk Rock Pioneer
angles.copy: Rewind to December 3rd, 1965: The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly broadened their sound and influenced countless artists. A pivotal moment in music history!

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of The Beatles legend John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, a visionary artist and advocate for peace. His legacy continues to inspire generations. What's the John Lennon song that resonates most with you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Celebrating the life and legacy of the iconic David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: Starman's Birthday
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we're celebrating the one and only David Bowie. A true chameleon of rock, his influence is immeasurable. Which Bowie era is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering 'The King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King Lives On
angles.copy: Happy heavenly 92nd birthday to the legend, Elvis Presley! His music changed the world forever. What's your favourite Elvis track to get you all shook up?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, his riffs are truly iconic. What's your favourite Pagey guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer-songwriter with a distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Sir Rod Stewart! A career spanning decades, a voice instantly recognisable. What's your all-time favourite Rod the Mod anthem?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of ska legends Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the fantastic Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing us hits like 'Our House' and 'Baggy Trousers'. What's your favourite Madness singalong?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for his distinctive blue-eyed soul voice and 80s hits, celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Wherever I Lay My Hat
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the brilliant Paul Young! From 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' to 'Every Time You Go Away', his soulful sound defined an era. What's your favourite Paul Young classic?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Jolene's Creator
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon, songwriter, and philanthropist. From 'Jolene' to '9 to 5', her music is timeless. What's your favourite Dolly hit?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That's Leader
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That's biggest hits to his successful solo career, he's a true British music staple. What's your favourite Gary Barlow song?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of international R&B and pop hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean King
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our cars with classics like 'Caribbean Queen' and 'When the Going Gets Tough'. What's your favourite Billy Ocean tune?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction ceremony
events.blurb: On January 24, 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first ever induction ceremony, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Making History
angles.copy: It was 38 years ago today, January 24th, 1989, that the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony. A monumental day for music history! Who do you think should have been in that first class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter and Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From his early days in Take That to his solo ventures, he's always been a fan favourite. What's your top Mark Owen moment?
